name: kmp-standards
description: Engineering standards for Kotlin Multiplatform projects, packaged so every project gets the same ones from one place.

plugins.name: kmp
plugins.description: Kotlin Multiplatform working standards: skills for adding a feature, changing a dependency, capturing an intent and writing a spec; a verifier subagent that runs both apps and reports what it saw; and hooks that refuse to let the documents drift from the code.
